procedure.procedureContent:
NEW MW196-MEMBERS: fixed resolution-time membership of every actual enemy whose occupied body intersects the caster-centered120-foot range and has caster-origin line of effect. No target cap or individual sight predicate. Hostility is actual intent/encounter relation, not alignment, reputation or caster preference. All qualifying hidden enemies are included privately; no roster disclosure. Ally, neutral, total-cover and beyond-range bodies are excluded. Later hostility/range changes neither add nor free an admitted target; new payment is needed for new membership. Unavailable authoritative hostility/geometry holds that positive branch.

NEW MW196-USE: block new activation/use of every source-defined active class/Base/Arch/Hero, ancestry, feat, item or companion ability and every spell, including zero-cost, silent, passive-labelled but optional/triggered activated uses. Also block automatic triggered ability outputs that would newly invoke an ability; consume no charge/cost for a blocked invocation and never queue it. Always-on passive states/defenses and already-established outputs continue. Attack, Dodge, Dash, Disengage, Guard, Search, ordinary movement/speech/object handling remain when legal; an extra class attack or special maneuver is an ability use and is blocked. Intrinsic anatomy/senses and mundane item function remain. This is use denial, not deletion of levels/maxima/passive acquisition.

NEW MW196-END: initial WIS save; success no new child. Failed save establishes ongoing nonconcentration denial despite preserved Instantaneous metadata. No hidden one-round/minute cap: it lasts until a successful WIS at a future regular target END, applicable removal or target terminal death. First repeat excludes an in-progress current turn; later regular ENDs each repeat even while suppressed. No extra-turn repeat. Attached phases/six-second outside bridge preserve the original cadence. Caster death does not erase admitted children. Suppression and initiative changes do not reset it.

NEW MW196-COMMIT: already committed actions finish; new active uses cannot begin. Completed paid Ready spell release is explicitly a use and is blocked while denial operates, even though it is not a new cast; the hold/concentration/original expiry continue and no Reaction is spent on rejected release. Existing spell effects and passive concentration continue; source-specific new command/upkeep activation is blocked. Already valid companion orders retain only their original attached-phase opportunity and expiry, never bank/replay. Uncommanded companions follow their own default; no controller/source deletion or automatic transfer.

NEW MW196-SOURCES: one child per admitted enemy, no concentration and no range tether. Same caster/target successful new admission replaces that caster child with its new DC/cadence; a successful new save/defense replaces nothing. Different casters coexist independently and each ending save removes only its own child. No stacking numerical penalty. Qualifying dispel can remove the selected ongoing child. No new weaker fallback where a whole component is prevented; shared guard history is unchanged because this use-only gate spends none.
procedure.sharedRequirements:
MD196-COMMON — KEEP all six exact native cards and eight class-access rows. Each root is Action,120 feet,V/S/F,rank9,base26RP,minimum actual casting-class level17. Five are Wizard only; Unmake also Cleric and Mage. Actual Wizard/Mage INT or Cleric WIS and acquired school bonuses determine DC. A legal source profile, real known/prepared route, voice, usable somatic hand, focus and permitted Action are prerequisites. Sufficient level/RP alone grants no spell. No generic upcast, extra targets, higher rank or automatic school union.
Preflight known illegality before paying. Freeze targets, mode, source identity, hostility/knowledge selectors and optional choices. Commit actual Action, RP and non-RP costs once, update protected class cadence and Refrain, make any genuine concentration transition, then permit the actual cast-time counter window. A failed save, absent privately selected spell, immunity, counter or later loss after legal commitment refunds nothing. An already committed parent does not overwrite a later interrupt's resource history. Source effects resolve only after surviving interruption. Wizard class Counterspell is acquired rank1/3RP/Reaction60feet/recharge2, INT+PB versus DC28 for these rank9 roots; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/Action60feet/recharge2 and INT+PB versus DC19 for an actual perceivable rank9 ongoing effect. These are different checks; no Greater Dispel acquisition is assumed.
Direct single-target casts require a known perceived body and caster line of effect within120feet, not visual sight unless the source demands it. Total cover excludes direct paths; no targeting through an opaque wall because a location is known. Mass Willbreaker's explicit all-enemy query is the separately selected area rule below. Actual mental defenses are component-specific. None of the six inherently inflicts Charmed or Frightened. Mind Blank's current Abjuration mode covers their actual mental spell components, including native mental Stunned; psychic damage immunity alone does not. True Seeing recognizes actual false perception, not every Illusion-school effect. Source class grants, physiological life, objective identity, soul and original history are distinct from current subjective belief and accessible memory.
All actor regular starts/ends are independently recorded. Regular starts refresh permitted budgets and tick positive recharge exactly once even if unable to act; ending idle turns vent only under the actual class rule. Spent budgets remain spent when a prohibition ends. Explicit elapsed deadlines continue during absence, suppression or loading. Bare hostile rounds use future target regular END markers excluding the current in-progress turn, end triggers phase10 and expiry phase20. Attached companions use their genuine future attached phase endpoints with the owner's preserved regular cycle, not an invented independent turn; outside initiative use6seconds/round. True extra turns neither advance regular clocks nor create recharge/Ready resets; an extra Action is not a turn. A positive inserted-turn actor remains held without its acquired source. No pulse scheduler is introduced.
Ordinary Ready actually casts/pays/provides components and starts concentration at preparation. Expiry is next own regular START; release needs the actual trigger, current legal Reaction, target/range/line and hold. No second cast/payment/counter window occurs. The distinct new gates below expressly state whether completed release is blocked. Ending a cast restriction does not restore an expired hold. Full commitment and release histories survive serialization.
Same-caster new concentration independently displaces the old concentration at commitment, before any save/counter. No failed replacement restores it. Repeated legal applications need new costs and actual defenses; blocked admission creates no latent application. Hard denial is claimed only by a successfully established whole-Action-equivalent component. Mind Collapse Stunned claims it. These proposed Willbreaker, private boundary prison, knowledge loss, single-spell prohibition and class-availability/belief components preserve basic Actions and voluntary agency, so do not claim that guard. Making a future implementation remove all Actions would require new review, not this classification. A spent guard never refunds after removal/suppression.
Store complete source-owned components, full underlying capability and memory versions, application order, original deadlines, costs, resources, custody, concentration endings and per-recipient decisions. Suppression never rewinds physical consequences, repeats an initial save, replays commands or restores ended sources. When an actual source is unavailable, record an unavailable branch with no invented acquisition, event outcome or cure. No spell here supplies a soul operation, a real plane, global memory access, or a time/history rewrite.

procedure.procedureContent:
NEW MP196-ADMIT: select up to five distinct perceived real creatures in120feet and line of effect, no forced five when fewer chosen. Each makes one initial INT save. Surviving failed-save child receives a separately authored private sensory reality, no damage. One caster concentration parent with fixed60 elapsed seconds from manifestation; this explicit finite completion supersedes Instantaneous only operationally while preserving raw source. No Enchantment extension because the printed card has no finite control duration. Each selected scene is fixed before private outcomes and contains only caster-authored imagery, not stolen memories.

NEW MP196-REALITY: each subject body remains at actual position. Anchor its real occupied bounding box expanded5feet at admission. Preserve real interior people/objects and all their ordinary interactions, but replace perception of exterior sight/sound/touch with its fixed convincing enclosure and scene. Subject may think, speak, concentrate, use Actions/BonusActions/Reactions and move legally inside. It cannot willingly cross or self-teleport/accept transport across the boundary while the belief gate operates. No real collision, cover, support, phantom items/attacks, Unconsciousness, automatic crits or full-Action loss. External attacks target the actual body normally. Real outgoing speech is audible outside; it grants no incoming true view. No caster live edits or omniscience.

NEW MP196-ESCAPE: subject can spend an ordinary Action and INT(Investigation) task check against recorded DC to recognize and end its own child. This express repeatable escape permits later fresh Actions. Positive exterior damage after defenses before temporaryHP independently ends that child after normal damage/condition checks; zero damage does not. Actual True Seeing with functioning senses/path recognizes this private overlay and ends that child, with no damage packet. This new named bridge does not import Mental Prison entry/exit5d10. Eligible source removal, voluntary concentration ending,60second expiry, target death, or actual involuntary displacement beyond its fixed boundary ends it. Normal knowledge that illusions exist is not free escape.

MP196-OWNERSHIP: one parent and at most five children; release never refills a slot. Caster death/lost concentration ends all; one child defense/dispel/death/escape leaves siblings. At most one Mind Prison(Mass) child per target across casters, replacing only after new admission; other named illusions retain their own rules. During suppression body/perception return normally while original parent/clock continue; moving outside boundary permanently ends that child. Resume only inside original boundary with no new initial save, damage or new reality. Cross-plane/unknown geometry is a held physical branch, not teleport permission.

procedure.procedureContent:

Permanent means no ordinary expiration/rest recovery, not deletion of player/save records. The private immutable baseline remains inaccessible to the character while sealed. This reconciles the actual permanent wording with the actual Core Until dispelled, and is explicitly local authorship.

NEW WI196-CATEGORIES: capture all then-accessible autobiographical events, relationships/recognition, semantic knowledge/languages, learned procedural skills/spell execution and personality preferences/goals/habits. Block access to those versions, not merely a recent event. Preserve objective identity, body, soul, current ability scores, levels/PB, HP/RP, intrinsic reflexes/senses, breathing, hunger/pain and basic voluntary actions. Acquired practical languages/proficiencies/active learned ability know-how are unavailable from erased versions; learned weapon use can still be attempted without its suppressed training bonus where ordinary rules permit. Always-on noncognitive class/anatomical defenses persist. No blanket score reduction, passive deletion, obedience or foreign knowledge. Each actual feature needs a provenance entry; missing cognition/dependency facts hold the affected use.

WI196-AGENCY: the same player/controller chooses actions for the same person. Former loyalty/preferences/relationships are genuinely unremembered; caster gains no orders or access to the baseline. The target can perceive, choose safety/help/refusal, learn new experiences and develop new preferences without a demanded replacement personality. Communication initially lacks erased languages; ordinary gestures/emotion are possible without granting a code or language. New formal skills/languages/spells require their genuine learning source and time. Private audit read/serialization is never an in-world learning event.

WI196-RESTORE: suppression exposes only versions hidden by this still-live seal; removal permanently releases that seal. Preserve later experiences and preferences with timestamps/provenance; restored past and genuinely learned later content coexist, contradictions remain remembered as separate experiences rather than retconning events. Prefer latest freely adopted post-wipe preference for current choice without deleting older preferences. Independent completed erasures/other seals still hide their own versions. No physical rewind, restored item, HP/RP refund, revived concentration, old Ready or reopened guard. Death pauses no indefinite seal; an actual source-qualified revival would return the same still-sealed continuing identity; no revival is supplied here.

WI196-VERSIONS: repeated casts capture only then-accessible versions, never clone a soul or overwrite original evidence. Concurrent seals mask union of version IDs, with distinct owners/DCs; removing one leaves others. Memory defenses block a new write before capture. Mind Blank can suppress this expressly ongoing seal, not reverse an independent completed Erase Mind event. World Rewrite preserves historical ever-known proof, but this seal blocks current learned invocation knowledge while operative; a source-valid suppression/removal may expose it. True extra turns neither advance regular clocks nor create recharge/Ready resets; an extra Action is not a turn. A positive inserted-turn actor remains held without its acquired source. No pulse scheduler is introduced.

Expiry is next own regular START; release needs the actual trigger, current legal Reaction, target/range/line and hold. No second cast/payment/counter window occurs. Full commitment and release histories survive serialization.

Repeated legal applications need new costs and actual defenses; blocked admission creates no latent application. These proposed Willbreaker, private boundary prison, knowledge loss, single-spell prohibition and class-availability/belief components preserve basic Actions and voluntary agency, so do not claim that guard. Store complete source-owned components, full underlying capability and memory versions, application order, original deadlines, costs, resources, custody, concentration endings and per-recipient decisions. Suppression never rewinds physical consequences, repeats an initial save, replays commands or restores ended sources. When an actual source is unavailable, record an unavailable branch with no invented acquisition, event outcome or cure.
